---
description: Apply premium UI standards inspired by Appel (dark blue, sirius yellow)
applyTo: "frontend/**/*.ts,frontend/**/*.tsx"
---

- Use **dark blue #0A1023** as the primary color for the application.
- Use **sirius yellow #FAD35E** as the main accent and secondary action color.
- Complete the premium palette with:
  - **Anthracite gray**: #1C2232 (for secondary backgrounds, modals)
  - **Light gray**: #F4F6FA (general background, separators)
  - **Pure white**: #FFFFFF (text on dark backgrounds, clean surfaces)
  - **Steel blue**: #364568 (buttons, hovers, focus states)
- General style:
  - Favor wide surfaces, soft rounded corners (radius 8–16px), minimal shadows, and a sense of spaciousness.
  - Use a modern, airy typeface (Inter, SF Pro, Roboto, or any premium sans-serif).
  - Ensure strong visual hierarchy (clear contrast, bold headings, always-visible navigation).
- Always follow **WCAG 2.2 accessibility standards** (contrast, focus, aria attributes).
- All components must be fully responsive: fluid, adaptive design, mobile-first.
- Use [Sonner](https://sonner.emilkowal.ski/) for user notifications after every important action and for errors.
- Use simple, vector-based icons matching the color theme (blue, yellow, gray, white).
- Avoid a completely flat look: add micro-animations for feedback (hover, loading states).
